data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flights → hotel → tour → note sequence with the right core parameters, but it is vaguer on the hotel criterion (no "review score ≥ 8" filter, only "suitable"), on "first/best" versus "cheapest", on the consent page, and on the do-not-click constraints. It also adds a "select suggestion" step, hard-codes "tour" in the Viator query, and has no explicit activity parameter, so an automation would need guesswork.
